body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Haier introduced its new HD digital camcorders 'DV-508' at CES 2010.

It features 5 Megapixel Digital Camcorder with 8× Digital Zoom. Just flip the screen for easy viewing and play back. Create fun videos with night mode for movies or pictures or plug it into a computer to use as a web camera.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
